about: Cited corrections applied by tools/build_isaref.py on top of the raw Ruby dump (emips/data/instructions.json, never hand-edited). Real MIPS wins: every entry cites the MIPS32 manual and was cross-checked with tools/audit_isa_binutils.py.

references.II-A: MIPS32 Architecture For Programmers, Volume II-A: The MIPS32 Instruction Set Manual (MD00086), Revision 5.04 -- instruction pages and Appendix A 'Instruction Bit Encodings'

corrections.name: LWL
corrections.ref: II-A LWL; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 Encoding of the Opcode Field'
corrections.why: Ruby table carried LH's opcode 100001; LWL is opcode 100010. With the old key LWL tied with LH and could never decode.

corrections.name: SWC2
corrections.ref: II-A SWC2; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 Encoding of the Opcode Field'
corrections.why: Ruby table carried SWC1's opcode 111001; SWC2 is opcode 111010. With the old key SWC2 tied with SWC1 and could never decode.

corrections.name: PREF
corrections.ref: II-A PREF; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 Encoding of the Opcode Field'
corrections.why: Ruby template used opcode 010001 (COP1), so PREF swallowed every COP1 word no more-specific FPU row matched; PREF is opcode 110011 (the row's own 'function' field already said so).

corrections.name: MOVZ.S
corrections.ref: II-A MOVZ.fmt; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 COP1 Encoding of Function Field When rs=S/D/W/L/PS'
corrections.why: Ruby template used function 001010 (CEIL.L); MOVZ.fmt is function 010010 (the row's own functionInfo fct already said so).

corrections.ref: II-A MOVF.fmt; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 COP1 Encoding of tf Bit When rs=S, D, or PS, Function=MOVCF'
corrections.why: Ruby template fixed the cc field (bits 20..18) to 000; MOVF.fmt takes any condition code cc, only bit 17 (0) and tf (bit 16 = 0) are fixed.

corrections.why: Ruby template set bit 6 to 1; EVA loads have offset[8:0] in bits 15..7, bit 6 = 0, function in bits 5..0.

corrections.name: JALR.HB
corrections.ref: II-A JALR.HB; II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 SPECIAL Opcode Encoding of Function Field'
corrections.why: Ruby template left hint bits 9..6 variable; JALR.HB is hint = 10000 exactly.

corrections.name: DDIV
corrections.ref: II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 SPECIAL Opcode Encoding of Function Field' (function 011110 is MIPS64-only)
corrections.why: DDIV is a MIPS64 instruction; on a MIPS32 core the word raises Reserved Instruction. The Ruby table listed it, which made the legacy '201 vector' 0x0000001E decode to DDIV.

corrections.name: DDIVU
corrections.ref: II-A App. A, 'MIPS32 SPECIAL Opcode Encoding of Function Field' (function 011111 is MIPS64-only)
corrections.why: DDIVU is a MIPS64 instruction; on a MIPS32 core the word raises Reserved Instruction. The Ruby table listed it, which made the legacy '201 vector' 0x0000001E decode to DDIV.
